item.title: Welcome to my site!
item.description: Hey! I’m Matthew. I currently work as a Lead Product Manager at Field building out essential renewable energy infrastructure. Previously, I’ve worked at Bulb and Cuckoo.

item.title: Happiness in small things
item.description: Today I got a gift. It made me happy. It wasn’t a large gift. It didn’t fill an impossibly deep hole in my existence. But it made me happy. It was socks. It made me happy.

item.title: The second best time is right now
item.description: “The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best is now.” Supposedly this comes from “an old Chinese proverb”. Some basic internet digging suggests this came into common usage in the 1960s (as prompted by someone equally suspicious about putting any vaguely wise-sounding soundbites in the “ancient Chinese wisdom” bucket too quickly.
